data.one_liner: Converts HTML strings to Quill Delta format for use with Quill editor.
data.what_it_does: This package parses HTML input and produces a list of Quill Delta operations that represent the same content. It supports a wide range of HTML tags, CSS styles, and custom block handlers.
use_when: Importing HTML content into a Quill editor
Migrating web‑based rich text to a Flutter app
Creating custom block embeds from HTML
avoid_when: You need a full HTML renderer or editor that works directly with HTML
The content contains complex table layouts beyond basic support
strengths: Wide tag and CSS support, including line‑height, colors, and text formatting
No build_runner or code generation required
weaknesses: Basic table support only, may not handle complex tables
No direct support for rendering HTML, only conversion to Delta
